/*  Year‑over‑year percentage growth in the total number of crimes  */
WITH yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        "YEAR"               AS yr,
        COUNT(*)             AS total_crimes
    FROM crime_incidents
    GROUP BY "YEAR"
)

SELECT
    yr,
    total_crimes,
    LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr)               AS prior_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr) IS NULL 
              OR LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr) = 0 
            THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
                ( (total_crimes - LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr))::numeric
                  / LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr) ) * 100,
                2
             )
    END                                                AS yoy_pct_growth
FROM yearly_totals
ORDER BY yr;

       SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crimes_2023,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crimes_2024
FROM crime_incidents ci JOIN district_names dn ON ci."DISTRICT" = dn.district_id

ORDER BY dn.district_name;

/*  Districts whose total number of crimes fell from 2023 to 2024  */
WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ci."DISTRICT"          AS district_id,
        ci."YEAR"              AS yr,
        COUNT(*)               AS cnt
    FROM crime_incidents ci
    WHERE ci."YEAR" IN (2023, 2024)          -- only the two years of interest
    GROUP BY ci."DISTRICT", ci."YEAR"
),

pivot AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2023,
        MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024
    FROM yearly_counts
    GROUP BY district_id
)

SELECT
    dn.district_name
FROM   pivot p
JOIN   district_names dn
       ON dn.district_id = p.district_id
WHERE  COALESCE(p.cnt_2024, 0) < COALESCE(p.cnt_2023, 0);   -- decline from 2023 to 2024
